• Cloud Computer: a dedicated space for projects that need one  
• Remote Control: your computer, one voice command away

results.title: Introducing Manus 2.0
results.content:
Each kind of work needs its own professional tools, but carrying every capability into every task makes the same work slower and more expensive. So Studio brings in only what your project calls for, keeping Manus's context focused on the work at hand. In this release, Studio gets major upgrades for both everyday work and professional creation: documents, spreadsheets, PDFs, and slides, as well as websites, code, games, and video. And for video and games, where the bar is especially high, we're introducing two all-new professional environments: Video Editor and Game Dev.

#### Video Editor: Make the first cut in minutes. Keep the final cut for yourself.

﻿ [...] Video Editor is built for short product ads (30 to 60 seconds), AI UGC, data motion graphics, tutorials, vlogs, and motion-led videos. You don't need any editing experience.

#### Alchemy mode: AI as your creative director

﻿

Video Editor also has Alchemy mode. You start from an idea, and Manus takes on the creative direction, using video and code generation together. The jump in quality is surprisingly big: the ideas are more creative, visual details are under tighter control, the motion is more polished, and the pacing of the edit is noticeably better. When quality matters most, Alchemy mode is the one to use. You can still fine-tune the result on the timeline afterward.

#### Game Dev: Build it. Ship it. Play it together.

﻿ [...] Cue is in early access and free to use with an invite code. You can start with MEETCUE, available to a limited number of early users on a first-come, first-served basis. Everyone who gets access also receives extra invite codes to share.

results.content:
## Part 2: Video Editor gives you the final cut

Manus usually gets the first version 80 to 90 percent there. But the last 10 to 20 percent is often what you care about most: the music a bit lower, a caption reworded, a shot half a second shorter, your own product photo instead of a generated one. These edits are small, but doing them only through chat is awkward. "Move it half a second earlier" is hard to say precisely, and fixing one thing can shift another. So we built Video Editor. It lives in Manus Studio, the Manus desktop app.

### Every layer is its own track [...] ﻿

 Some of what I made with Manus this month, 16 seconds, music from the launch film. Notion plays a compressed preview How to start yours? Choose Video in Manus and describe the video you want in one sentence, on web or desktop. Video Editor is in Manus Studio, the desktop app for macOS and Windows. On the web, click "Edit in Video Editor" and you'll be guided to download the desktop app and edit on the full timeline.
